arguments.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS breast_cancer_patients_total FROM omop.condition_occurrence co JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4116071
SELECT MIN(observation_period_start_date) AS min_start, MAX(observation_period_end_date) AS max_end, COUNT(*) AS observation_periods FROM omop.observation_period

SELECT TOP 20 condition_end_date, COUNT(*) AS n FROM omop.condition_occurrence co JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4116071 GROUP BY condition_end_date ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS active_breast_cancer_patients FROM omop.condition_occurrence co JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id LEFT JOIN omop.death d ON d.person_id = co.person_id WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 4116071 AND co.condition_end_date IS NULL AND d.person_id IS NULL
